headline: On last trading session, Indian markets snapped a two-week winning streak due to elevated crude oil prices and foreign selling.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Surging Brent crude oil prices reaching six-month highs pressured domestic shares.
Persistent Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) selling weighed heavy on D-Street sentiment.
Macro uncertainty and weak institutional flows created resistance for equity markets.
Turbulence across global markets spilled over into domestic indices.
whatHappening: The Nifty settled around the 22,600 mark as markets snapped a two-week rally.
The Sensex recorded notable losses over the turbulent trading week of Oct 19-23.
IT stocks provided brief support amid buying interest, though broader indices ended lower.
Indian markets remain shut for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 26 October.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed lower on the last trading day, snapping a two-week rally as rising crude oil prices and continuous foreign fund outflows dragged sentiment. Nifty ended near 22,600 amid market volatility. D-Street remains closed today for the weekend and will reopen for trading on Monday, 26 October.
